texts.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着[From.GetName]星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
texts.en:
We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly home to a pre-space civilization.

There is a large space station of some kind located between the ring world and its star. We are receiving a transmission from it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

texts.zh:
欢迎来到保护区，智慧生物。这个完全自动化的设施是在74605338个周期前建立的，是一个自然保护区。这里分割为四个自治的生态群系，每个分区拥有来自不同生物圈的非智慧植物和动物。

为了保护脆弱的生物圈，进入设施目前是受限制的。

在任何情况下都禁止接近此设施。
texts.en:
Welcome to the Sanctuary, sapient. This fully automated facility was established 74,605,338 cycles ago to serve as a nature reserve. Our self-sustaining biome segments feature a selection of non-intelligent flora and fauna originating from four distinct biospheres.

To protect these fragile biospheres, access to our facilities is currently restricted.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

label.zh: 我们的传感器显示你们的环形世界中有文明存在的迹象。
label.en: Our sensors show signs of civilization on your ring world.

responses.zh:
保护区一开始建立时，生物圈内所有的生物都被全部登记了。记录显示，没有生命体的智力水平是接近智能。你们的传感器一定是出错了。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
responses.en:
All species present in our biomes were thoroughly cataloged when the Sanctuary was first established. Records indicate that none of them displayed intelligence levels approaching sapience. Your sensors must be mistaken.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

responses.zh:
此设施是由西渺建成，历时412周期。正式完成并投入运行是在74,605,338周期前。西渺或者西渺飞船最近一次有记录的来访是在67,103,853周期前。从那之后就再也没有过西渺或西渺附属飞船来访的记录。

记录中共有38,201次未经授权的飞船试图进入。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
responses.en:
This facility was constructed by the Ximio over a period of 412 cycles. It was completed and fully functional 74,605,338 cycles ago. The last recorded visit by a Ximio vessel occurred 67,103,853 cycles ago. There are no recorded visits by Ximio or Ximio-affiliated vessels since that date.

There are 38,201 failed attempts by unauthorized vessels to access this facility on record.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

responses.zh:
保护区的自动服务祝您度过愉快的一天，智慧生物。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
responses.en:
The automated services of the Sanctuary bid you a pleasant day, sapient.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

summary.text:
# 遭遇环形世界 / Ring World Encountered

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次进入标记了 sanctuary_system 的星系，系内有 sanctuary_core 舰队，且有原始文明居住的行星时（on_entering_system_first_time）。

Entering for the first time a system flagged sanctuary_system that has a sanctuary_core fleet and a planet owned by a primitive civilisation (on_entering_system_first_time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

350：环形世界；“接通”或无视。→ 351 避难所的自动广播（建立通讯），有三个对话选项（你们环世界上有文明迹象 / 谁建造了这里 / 再见）。

350: a ring world; "on screen" or ignore. -> 351 the Sanctuary's automatic transmission (communications are established), with three dialogue options (signs of civilisation on your ring world / who built this facility / goodbye).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

接通 / 无视；对话选项都是对白回复。

On screen / ignore; the dialogue options are replies only.
